features.title: Facilitator Dashboard
features.description: The Facilitator area is where you manage the active Syllabus, learners, lessons, scheduling, and account-level tools.
features.howToUse: Use Syllabus, Learners, Lesson Library, Account, and related facilitator tools to manage learning. Ms. Sonoma can also open supported surfaces and help you work with current app state.

features.title: Goals Clipboard
features.description: The Goals clipboard is the UI where you view and edit Goals and Notes for the selected learner (or facilitator).
features.howToUse: Click the 'Goals' button to open it. Ms. Sonoma can also help you review what's saved or suggest what to write.

features.title: Lessons Overlay
features.description: The Lessons overlay is a quick way to browse, search, and act on lessons (schedule, assign/approve, edit, or review).
features.howToUse: Click the 'Lessons' button, or ask Ms. Sonoma to show lessons and help you find the one you want.

features.title: Syllabus Month View
features.description: Month view is the monthly presentation of the active Syllabus. It shows the same planned lessons, reviews, forecast suggestions, historical records, and no-school dates without creating a separate calendar workflow.
features.howToUse: Open Syllabus and choose Month view beside the date range, or ask Ms. Sonoma to open the month view for the selected learner.

features.title: Lesson Planner
features.description: Syllabus planning combines facilitator-authored plan details with dated instructional intent and learning forecasts. Forecasts remain proposals until they are accepted or materialized.
features.howToUse: Ask Ms. Sonoma to review the selected learner's Syllabus, current plan details, or upcoming forecast and help prepare the next planning action.

features.title: Curriculum Guidance
features.description: Curriculum Guidance is the facilitator-authored planning context stored with the learner's Syllabus, including requirements, personal goals, and guidance about what to emphasize or avoid.
features.howToUse: Ask Ms. Sonoma to review the selected learner's Curriculum Guidance or tell her what needs to change. Changes to active Syllabus intent stay under facilitator control.

features.title: Weekly Pattern
features.description: Weekly Pattern is part of Plan Details in the active Syllabus. It expresses the facilitator-authored rhythm of subjects across the week.
features.howToUse: Ask Ms. Sonoma to review the selected learner's weekly pattern or tell her the pattern you want to change.

features.title: Custom Subjects
features.description: Custom subjects let you add your own subject names for planning and scheduling.
features.howToUse: Ask 'show my custom subjects' to list them, or say 'add custom subject <name>'.

features.title: No-School Dates
features.description: No-school dates mark days the learner won’t do school so planning can avoid them.
features.howToUse: Ask 'show no-school dates' to report what’s saved for the selected learner.

features.title: Medals
features.description: Medals summarize a learner’s best performance on lessons.
features.howToUse: Ask 'show medals' for the selected learner.
